answer: An adversary running 28 aliases therefore needs 24 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in copper, expire in pearl, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3205 identities would post 1970 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
